items.name: theme
items.title: Ninaero theme
items.description: Shared light and dark tokens with Ninaero squircle Button styling.

theme.font-sans: 'Google Sans Flex Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

@utility ninaero-paper-ruled.background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(transparent 0 calc(var(--ninaero-paper-step) - 1px), var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) calc(var(--ninaero-paper-step) - 1px) var(--ninaero-paper-step))

@utility ninaero-paper-ruled-*.background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(transparent 0 calc(var(--ninaero-paper-step) - 1px), var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) calc(var(--ninaero-paper-step) - 1px) var(--ninaero-paper-step))

@utility ninaero-paper-grid.background-image: linear-gradient(var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 1px, transparent 1px)

@utility ninaero-paper-grid-*.background-image: linear-gradient(var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 1px, transparent 1px)

@utility ninaero-checker.background-image: conic-gradient(var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 0 75%, transparent 0)

@utility ninaero-checker-*.background-image: conic-gradient(var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 0 75%, transparent 0)

@utility ninaero-checker-wide.background-image: conic-gradient(var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 0 75%, transparent 0)

@utility ninaero-checker-wide-*.background-image: conic-gradient(var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 25%, transparent 0 50%, var(--ninaero-pattern-ink, var(--paper-rule)) 0 75%, transparent 0)

@utility ninaero-display-ink.background-image: linear-gradient(to bottom in oklab, var(--display-ink-top), var(--display-ink-bottom))

.ninaero-slider-track.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--input-fill), black var(--input-recess-shade-weight)), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--input-edge)

.ninaero-slider-thumb.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in oklab, var(--slider-thumb-top), white 6%), var(--shadow-control)
.ninaero-slider-thumb.transition: border-color 80ms ease-out, background-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out

.ninaero-tabs-trigger.transition: background-color 100ms ease-out, border-color 100ms ease-out, box-shadow 100ms ease-out, color 100ms ease-out

.ninaero-tabs-list[data-variant=default].background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -45% in oklab, var(--tabs-active-highlight), transparent 75%), linear-gradient(180deg in oklab, var(--tabs-active-top), var(--tabs-active-fill) 48%, var(--tabs-active-bottom))

.ninaero-tabs-list[data-variant=line] >.background-image: linear-gradient(180deg in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--tabs-marker-fill), white 10%), var(--tabs-marker-fill))

.ninaero-toggle.transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out

.ninaero-button.transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out, box-shadow 80ms ease-out, transform 80ms ease-out

.ninaero-button--secondary.background-image: linear-gradient(180deg in oklab, var(--button-paper-highlight), transparent 55%, var(--button-paper-shade))
.ninaero-button--secondary.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--button-paper-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--button-paper-shade), var(--button-cast-shadow, var(--shadow-control))

.ninaero-button--destructive.background-image: linear-gradient(180deg in oklab, var(--button-destructive-highlight), transparent 55%, var(--button-destructive-shade))
.ninaero-button--destructive.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--button-destructive-highlight), inset 0 -1px 0 var(--button-destructive-shade), var(--button-cast-shadow, var(--shadow-control))

:root.--font-sans: 'Google Sans Flex Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
